snippet.title: Club Penguin Zero Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
As Club Penguin Imagined comes to a close in March 2025, get ready for something truly magical.

Club Penguin Zero is a brand new Club Penguin experience like you've never seen before.

Combining elements from all different eras of Club Penguin to create a definitive, one-of-a-kind game that modernizes Club Penguin in an all new exciting way.

Read more about Club Penguin Zero over at www.cpimagined.net/whats-new/lets-talk-about-zero and join us on our journey in 2025 to create a lasting legacy.

Want to continue the hype train? Head on over to @clubpenguinimagined and join the island and Discord as we wrap up, and see just what our team is capable of, with all new mechanics, minigames and more!

Check it out! - https://www.cpzero.net/
Twitter -   https://twitter.com/CPZeroOfficial
Discord -   https://discord.gg/N8sEcSdzwc
